page_blocks.title: 01 // IDENTITY
page_blocks.bio: I am a Computer Science student specializing in Cyber Security at Jeppiaar University. Beyond academics, I bridge the gap between deep technical research and community leadership. I serve as the Secretary for the IEEE Student Branch and actively tutor junior students in practical cybersecurity. My primary focus lies at the intersection of hardware security, workflow automation, and open-source innovation.

list.name: Offensive & Defensive Security
list.description: Proficient in network protocols, Burp Suite, and vulnerability assessments. Expanding into Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) and secure remote access architecture.

list.name: Firmware-level Protection
list.description: Researching and developing low-level security solutions, including UEFI/BIOS-embedded anti-theft tracking systems that operate independently of the OS.

list.name: Workflow Automation
list.description: Leveraging tools like n8n, Python scripts, and AI-assisted workflows to build scalable, automated systems and streamline daily research processes.

projects_list.name: SecureBIOS
projects_list.description: A firmware-level anti-theft system designed to embed security protocols directly into the BIOS/UEFI, ensuring persistence even if the hard drive is wiped or replaced.

projects_list.name: Enterprise GRC Architecture
projects_list.description: Developed a comprehensive Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) framework and policy dossier for deploying secure remote access solutions.

projects_list.name: AI-Based OS Architecture
projects_list.description: Actively researching and designing the foundational architecture for a completely new operating system that integrates AI models at the core level.
